newsitem.title: UK: IBCA raises Northern Rock L-term rating.
newsitem.headline: IBCA raises Northern Rock L-term rating.

text.p: IBCA, the European rating agency, said on Tuesday it had raised its Long-term rating of Northern Rock Building Society to A plus from A.
It said its other ratings were unchanged, with its Short-term at A1, Individual at A/B and Legal at four.
"Northern Rock's low operating costs enable it to offer very competitive rates to savers and borrowers," IBCA said in a statement.
"Consequently, it has been able to grow faster than the sector without sacrificing loan quality."
IBCA said Northern Rock's imminent conversion to a bank from a building society was unlikely to result in any change to its well-established and successful low-cost strategy.
